Considering that the matter relates to the offence under Section 376 IPC, the notice of the appeal be served upon the victim/prosecutrix through the concerned SHO, returnable on 26.09.2025.

Additionally, the IO shall inform the complainant about her right to free legal aid/representation in accordance with the decision of the Supreme Court in Jagjeet Singh v. Ashish Mishra, reported as (2022) 9 SCC 321 and if required, shall assist the prosecutrix in approaching the Member Secretary,
Delhi High Court Legal Services Committee who may appoint a panel counsel, if so requested.

This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 09/09/2025 at 22:28:07 thereof by the victim.

The IO is directed to facilitate the victim in approaching the Member Secretary, DSLSA and ensure that subject to completion of formalities, the awarded amount be released to the victim at the earliest, if not already done.
